WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    a.district_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY region
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.district_id,
    s1.region,
    s1.cnt,
    s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.region = s2.region
  WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt
),
step4_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(s3.cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM step3
),
step5_vals AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.cnt * 1.0 / s4.avg_cnt as ratio
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4_val s4
  WHERE s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ratio DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
min_from_step5 AS (
  SELECT MIN(ratio) as min_ratio FROM step5_vals
)
SELECT 
  s3.district_id,
  s3.region,
  s3.cnt,
  s3.diff,
  s3.cnt * 1.0 / s4.avg_cnt as ratio
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4_val s4
CROSS JOIN min_from_step5 m
WHERE s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
  AND s3.cnt * 1.0 / s4.avg_cnt >= m.min_ratio
ORDER BY ratio DESC
